standard_prerequisites.name: Milnor sequence
standard_prerequisites.use: H^q(U, R lim K_n) = lim H^q(U,K_n) when R^1 lim vanishes.

core_obligations: For U ∈ B, (2)(a) gives H^q(U,K_n) = H^0(U, H^q(K_n)) by the cohomology-over-U-trivial lemma (proof lines 9814-9817).

By the Milnor sequence and (2)(b), H^q(U,K) = lim H^0(U, H^q(K_n)); since lim H^q(K_n) is a sheaf and assumption (1) gives the basis, sheafification yields H^q(K) = lim H^q(K_n) (proof lines 9818-9824).
proof_roadmap: Take the limit and sheafify over the basis.
difficulty_reason: The proof combines the per-open triviality lemma, the Milnor sequence and sheafification over the basis B.
